# sync

Types from the Go package `sync` (a library PocketBase builds on), as JavaScript sees them: they turn up as values of [PocketBase's types](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase) and of hook events.

## sync.Locker

A Locker represents an object that can be locked and unlocked.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `lock()` | <code>(): void</code> |  |
| `unlock()` | <code>(): void</code> |  |

## sync.Mutex

A Mutex is a mutual exclusion lock.
The zero value for a Mutex is an unlocked mutex.

A Mutex must not be copied after first use.

In the terminology of [the Go memory model],
the n'th call to [`Mutex.unlock`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sync#syncmutex) “synchronizes before” the m'th call to [`Mutex.lock`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sync#syncmutex)
for any n < m.
A successful call to [`Mutex.tryLock`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sync#syncmutex) is equivalent to a call to Lock.
A failed call to TryLock does not establish any “synchronizes before”
relation at all.

[the Go memory model]: https://go.dev/ref/mem

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `lock()` | <code>(): void</code> | Lock locks m. If the lock is already in use, the calling goroutine blocks until the mutex is available. |
| `tryLock()` | <code>(): boolean</code> | TryLock tries to lock m and reports whether it succeeded. |
| `unlock()` | <code>(): void</code> | Unlock unlocks m. It is a run-time error if m is not locked on entry to Unlock. |

## sync.RWMutex

A RWMutex is a reader/writer mutual exclusion lock.
The lock can be held by an arbitrary number of readers or a single writer.
The zero value for a RWMutex is an unlocked mutex.

A RWMutex must not be copied after first use.

If any goroutine calls [`RWMutex.lock`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sync#syncrwmutex) while the lock is already held by
one or more readers, concurrent calls to [`RWMutex.rLock`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sync#syncrwmutex) will block until
the writer has acquired (and released) the lock, to ensure that
the lock eventually becomes available to the writer.
Note that this prohibits recursive read-locking.
A [`RWMutex.rLock`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sync#syncrwmutex) cannot be upgraded into a [`RWMutex.lock`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sync#syncrwmutex),
nor can a [`RWMutex.lock`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sync#syncrwmutex) be downgraded into a [`RWMutex.rLock`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sync#syncrwmutex).

In the terminology of [the Go memory model],
the n'th call to [`RWMutex.unlock`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sync#syncrwmutex) “synchronizes before” the m'th call to Lock
for any n < m, just as for [`Mutex`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sync#syncmutex).
For any call to RLock, there exists an n such that
the n'th call to Unlock “synchronizes before” that call to RLock,
and the corresponding call to [`RWMutex.rUnlock`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sync#syncrwmutex) “synchronizes before”
the n+1'th call to Lock.

[the Go memory model]: https://go.dev/ref/mem

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `rLock()` | <code>(): void</code> | RLock locks rw for reading. |
| `tryRLock()` | <code>(): boolean</code> | TryRLock tries to lock rw for reading and reports whether it succeeded. |
| `rUnlock()` | <code>(): void</code> | RUnlock undoes a single [`RWMutex.rLock`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sync#syncrwmutex) call; it does not affect other simultaneous readers. It is a run-time error if rw is not locked for reading on entry to RUnlock. |
| `lock()` | <code>(): void</code> | Lock locks rw for writing. If the lock is already locked for reading or writing, Lock blocks until the lock is available. |
| `tryLock()` | <code>(): boolean</code> | TryLock tries to lock rw for writing and reports whether it succeeded. |
| `unlock()` | <code>(): void</code> | Unlock unlocks rw for writing. It is a run-time error if rw is not locked for writing on entry to Unlock. |
| `rLocker()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sync#synclocker">Locker</a></code> | RLocker returns a [`Locker`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sync#synclocker) interface that implements the [`Locker.lock`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sync#synclocker) and [`Locker.unlock`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sync#synclocker) methods by calling rw.RLock and rw.RUnlock. |
